name: Nextera Packaging
old_description: Food has had a profound ability to bring people together throughout history and across cultures. We believe we get to play a small, yet influential role, in supporting that powerful connection.
about:
Nextera Packaging is based in St. Paul, Minnesota, and was founded in 1976. The company operates as a national supplier of food packaging products and automation equipment, focusing exclusively on the food industry.

The company provides a range of packaging products, including eco-friendly options, and automation equipment for food processors and packers. It positions itself as a specialist in food packaging rather than a general packaging distributor, offering expertise to help customers select the right packaging with less trial and error.

Nextera serves food processors and packers across North America, helping them package food safely, beautifully, and sustainably. Its customer base includes food manufacturing operations seeking to reduce trial and error in packaging selection and improve efficiency through automation.

The company differentiates itself by focusing exclusively on food packaging, offering industry expertise and relationship-driven service to solve packaging challenges. It also emphasizes sustainable materials and automation solutions to improve efficiency and support food processors' sustainability goals.
